result: If I were to consider changing the world in one significant way, I would focus on promoting universal access to education and information. By ensuring that everyone, regardless of their location or background, has access to quality education and reliable information, we can empower individuals to improve their lives, contribute more effectively to society, and foster innovation and understanding across cultures. This foundational change could help address many other global issues, from poverty and health to environmental sustainability and social justice.
